land.note_B: slope-arc-r1 B (slope-arc-20261116): band centre re-timed to the clean landings (33 clean of 78 current-geometry passes, 11-14 3cf4 .. 11-16 7af0). kappa_table = the clean passes' median command (pre-compensation steer, smoothed 0.15 m) expressed as the curvature this layer's formula needs (kappa = (pre - c_eff) * g(v)) and placed at x + v*lead_s, so with lead_s 0.25 the centre reproduces the clean command: ~1680-1720 from the first LAND8 frame to x 0.85 (s 0.6), down to ~1520 at x 1.3-1.5 (near-straight L2), back to ~1670 from x 2.1 (arc). Equivalent to the clean curvature profile (first bend from s +0.15, peak 47-50 deg/m at s 0.7-0.8, near-straight s 1.2-1.5, arc 28-34 deg/m from s 2.0) advanced by the measured 0.35-0.45 m command lead and scaled by the measured command/curvature ratio. x = lap_pos metres since the LAND8 crossing = (s_seam + 0.22) / 0.967. m_hi 90 -> 60 (upper = clean median + 60 ~ clean p75; it is what cuts the press-type catch-up at 1780 to ~1760-1780), m_lo 90 with the inside-yield. turn_ref = clean median heading turned since the seam (old table lagged it 12-18 deg -> head -50..-80 us on every arc2-era pass, PID cut by 140-200 us). k_head 4 -> 2 / head_lim 80 -> 40 (_bm_yaw0 offset ~20 deg in 7 of 17 arc2-era passes). x_bend 0.85 -> 0.3 (floor from the first LAND8 frame). x_end 2.0 -> 2.3.

approach.note: landing-20261119 approach: lap_pos DOWN+1.5 m .. LAND8 (about the last 0.6 m / 0.5 s of the slope). Raises the pre-compensation command to the smallest value whose sent command (play_comp emulated with comp = play_comp.json values; keep them equal) is >= straight_us (closest candidate to it), never above straight_us + 60 (scan out/approach_scan.txt: target 40 / cap 130 held the sent command at median +102 us through play_comp's no-fall hold = too much right), never lowers it; camera near error < -0.2 -> no action. Ends when lap_pos switches to LAND8; the last floor is kept for hold_m 0.3 m after LAND8 (only raises; a higher land-band command is kept). Delete or enabled false = off.

pulse.note: landing2-20261120 pulse (offline candidate, NOT deployed; needs arc2.py b9e34428): camera-gated pre-landing floor. On valid slope frames with lap_pos anchor DOWN and distance xe = since_anchor + v*age in [x_on, x_off] the pre-compensation command is raised so that the emulated sent command is >= centre + g*sent_us, g = clip((image_error - e0)/(e1 - e0), 0, 1); only raises, never above centre + pre_cap_us (= bottom_owner cap_us 240), and only while still on the slope (ends when live_pid detects the landing). On the car xe (lap_pos DOWN distance + v*age, age <= 0.25 s) is ~2.10 at the last slope frame and ~1.78 at 0.35 s before LAND8 (replay of the 18 landings, out/T_pulse_xe.txt) -> x_on 1.75 starts ~0.3-0.4 s before the landing. Delete the pulse block or enabled false = off (frame-identical to arc2.json 6589ca65).

r2.note: blind-v-r2 (blind-v-20261119, offline candidate): V crossing after curve 1 with the circle-crossing r4 rules. Camera owns C1e+0..4.8 m; heading hold C1e+4.8..7.5 m (0.2 m blend in, 0.3 m blend out -> camera alone from 7.8 m; curve-2 brake zone from 9.8 m). Measured (133 passes 11-16..11-18): single-line / fallback-corridor frames C1e+4.75..7.25 m, camera lateral bias |p90| > 3 cm 5.5..7.5 m. Reference = distance-weighted IMU heading over the last 0.8 m before 4.8 m (swing -> last 0.4 m; else no hold), then corrected by the camera lateral slope over 3.3..4.8 m (two lines, clean), within +-2.5 deg: the plain heading reference is ~+1.0..1.4 deg left of the lane (the car is still settling from curve 1), which made r1 drift 10-17 cm left on 11-18. k_psi 10 / k_gz 1.2 / ki 8 (+-25 us, hold only), camera trim +-36 us from consistent frames, |dpsi| > 12 deg -> released. No map fallback. PWM untouched. Lost frames are not handled (live_pid calls the lost hook only for blind_c2). Delete the r2 key (or enabled false) = r1.
